## Research Interests

My current research examines how agricultural producers and landowners make decisions about adopting conservation programs and management practices. Going forward, I am interested in studying how agricultural, food, and land-use policies influence producer and consumer decisions. I also plan to work on regenerative agriculture, climate-change adaptation, and interdisciplinary studies that integrate economic, agronomic, biophysical, and management data.
